distribution.narrative: Accepted for Taiwan from Beaver & Liu (2010). The source states that the taxon, published there as Hypocryphalus formosanus, was known only from the holotype.

host_note: Beaver & Liu (2010) reports the host as unknown; no host taxon is promoted.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Cryphalus schedli Johnson, 2020.

taxonomic_history.name: Hypocryphalus formosanus
taxonomic_history.note: Published name currently treated as a synonym; original-description p. 62.

taxonomic_history.name: Cryphalus schedli
taxonomic_history.note: Current accepted name in the integrated taxonomic backbone.

nomenclature_note: The current accepted identity is Cryphalus schedli Johnson, 2020, VSN_1826. Beaver & Liu (2010) treats the source name Hypocryphalus formosanus Schedl. The historical source identity is preserved in the Source Record and profile nomenclature section; the stable VSN remains mapped to the current canonical taxon.
